title: SHWFS-AO accepted cross-backend physical comparison baseline
description: Canonical shape of the accepted AO-REF-018 cross-backend baseline artifact. This is the version-2 runtime contract enforced by shwfs_ao.validation.regression and emitted by scripts/generate_cross_backend_candidate.py; the packaged reference_metrics/cross_backend/cross_backend_baseline.json instance validates against this schema byte-for-byte. Numerical input witnesses retain raw byte provenance and permit strict full-array roundoff comparisons across platforms.

comparison_config.description: Open record of the comparison's own inputs, pinned by its config_hash rather than by a field list. The runtime contract in shwfs_ao.validation.regression additionally recomputes config_hash from these contents and requires root_seed to equal the top-level root_seed; JSON Schema can state neither a content hash nor a cross-field equality, so those two rules live only there.

allOf.$comment: A clean tree has no divergence from the recorded commit, so it cannot also carry patch evidence of one.
A dirty tree must record the content hash of exactly what diverged from the recorded commit.

nonempty_string.description: A string carrying at least one non-whitespace character. minLength alone admits "   ", which the application validators reject with str.strip(): a schema that accepted it would be the weaker of the two gates while claiming to mirror them, and an all-whitespace estimator, rationale or acceptance reason documents nothing.

root_seed.description: A seed is a non-negative integer. JSON booleans are not integers here, so a document seeded with true is rejected rather than read as seed 1.

content_hash.description: A 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest. The length bounds are not redundant with the pattern: jsonschema evaluates patterns with Python's re.search, whose $ also matches before one trailing newline, so the pattern alone admits a digest followed by "\n", which the application validators reject.

statistical_definition.description: What a comparison estimated from repeated realizations must state, as fields rather than as prose: an average means nothing without the sample count, estimator, bins or lags, and uncertainty method behind it, and a sentence saying so cannot be checked. The narrative is required beside them, not instead of them. Mirrors STATISTICAL_DEFINITION_FIELDS in shwfs_ao.validation.regression.

sample_count.description: One realization has no dispersion, so it cannot carry the uncertainty this comparison reports.

fixture_numerical_input.description: Witness of a direct array fixture. Its raw fixture hash is the stable hash of the witnessed array itself, so there is no hash preimage to record and both payloads are null.

dm_numerical_input.description: Witness of a DM influence stack. Its raw component hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical model configuration preimage, which in turn binds the backend configuration preimage by hash, so both payloads are required.

numerical_input.description: Lossless full-array input witness; runtime validation checks compressed data, content SHA-256, finiteness and fixed roundoff tolerances. No metric tolerance is encoded here. Which payloads are present depends on the input: see fixture_numerical_input and dm_numerical_input. JSON Schema cannot state that shape entries are integers rather than integer-valued numbers (48.0 validates as an integer here), bound the product of the shape, or check the decoded data against shape and values_sha256; the runtime contract does all three.

data.description: Padded standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) of the zlib stream, which is what the runtime's strict base64 decoding accepts. The pattern's $ also matches before one trailing newline under Python's re.search, so newlines are refused separately.

source_payload.description: Canonical DM configuration hash preimage; null for direct array fixtures (narrowed per input by fixture_numerical_input and dm_numerical_input).

backend_source_payload.description: Canonical inner DM backend hash preimage; null for direct array fixtures (narrowed per input by fixture_numerical_input and dm_numerical_input).
